confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderate confidence; accommodation is less certain because of July demand. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draught, matching the comparables. Cocktail is set at about 2.3 times the beer anchor and wine glass near beer level, as relative estimates. The FX value came from search-result summaries of the RBA table, not from opening the RBA page, and the 15 October date metadata was flagged as inconsistent, so verify it on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied Athens, Berlin and Amsterdam figures. Madrid restaurant meals sit near Athens and Berlin and well below Amsterdam; coffee sits below Athens and Berlin; accommodation is roughly in line with Athens and Berlin, with a modest allowance for July demand.
